kicker: Wedding season, "rate kya hai?" 20 baar roz
title: "Rate kya hai?" ka jawab *sirf rate* mat do.
message:
Namaste [naam] 🙏 aaj 22K gold: *₹[rate]/gm*.
[Design] ka andaaza: ~[X] gm, making [Y]%.
Showroom pe *[din] [time]* aayein? Aapke liye 5 designs alag rakh denge.
why: sirf rate = customer agli dukaan se compare karega. *Design + visit slot* = aapke paas aayega.
caption:
Shaadi ke season mein "rate kya hai?" roz aata hai. Aur zyaadatar jewellers sirf ek number bhej dete hain. Customer wo number leke 4 aur dukaanon se poochta hai. 💍

Behtar reply:
1️⃣ Aaj ka rate
2️⃣ Unke design ka weight + making ka andaaza
3️⃣ Showroom visit ka fixed slot
4️⃣ "Aapke liye designs alag rakh denge"

Rate pe nahi, visit pe jeeto. Save karo 🔖
